svg.text: K11 Ambient storage column (650 mm) — option A and option B
A: an aisle shuttle pulls boxes sideways out of two rack faces. B: the storage carriage digs 3 × 3 stacks from the top.
A: 72 lidded + 9 cool + ≤ 37 nested · 4–6 s · 3 motors
B: ≈ 120 positions · top box 15–18 s · mean 50–70 s
B needs waivers: STO-003 (≤ 30 s), CAP-024 (cool)
OPTION A — compliant: S4 aisle shuttle
front face, seen from the aisle
OPTION B — cheap: 3 × 3 stacks dug from the top

g.text: 1/4 A: carriage to the level; J-hook pulls the box into the aisle
2/4 A: up to the roof hatch; storage gripper takes the box (4–6 s)
3/4 A: put-away: a box comes down, carriage to a rear level
4/4 A: J-hook pushes it into the rear face; back up
1/4 B: servo hook lifts the roof hatch; hoist to stack 1
2/4 B: the box above is lifted onto stack 3
3/4 B: the wanted box comes up; hatch closes
4/4 B: off to the cell; one box above cost ≈ +10–12 s
